query:
SELECT
            o.guest_email,
            o.order_key,
            p.name AS product_name,
            f.email AS farmer_email
        FROM orders o
        JOIN stock    s ON s.id = o.stock_id
        JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id
        JOIN farmers  f ON f.id = p.farmer_id
        WHERE o.id        = $1
          AND p.farmer_id = $2
